## Rest Haven Memorial Park Rules and Regulations

Rest Haven Memorial Park was established in 1970, according to the laws of the State of Texas. It provides an atmosphere of beauty and serenity, offering a permanent place for family and friends to gather in honor and remembrance of their loved ones. Please maintain an attitude of appropriate respect throughout your visit. Should you have any questions or concerns about the guidelines and policies of the Memorial Park, please feel free to contact us during regular business office hours.

### Guidelines for Flower Placement and Decorations

As in any park, Rest Haven Memorial Park has set guidelines. Therefore, we respectfully ask for your cooperation with the following simple requirements to provide a peaceful and welcoming setting for all who visit.

• Fresh-cut flowers and artificial flowers may be placed on your property at any time throughout the year. They will be removed when they have lost their original beauty or become seasonally inappropriate at the discretion of Cemetery Management. 
• Fresh-cut flowers, artificial flowers, and personal memorabilia must fit securely within the vase assembly of your granite upright marker, flat bronze marker, or mausoleum arbor vase. 
• Seasonal decorations will be removed on the following dates: *January 13 th *April 28 th *June 28 th *September 28 th 
• Fresh or artificial holiday greenery and flowers may be placed beginning the first week of December and will be removed starting the second week of January. During this time, holiday greenery and flowers are permitted outside the vase assembly of your marker. 
• For your family's convenience, Rest Haven has provided a storage building that is accessible by contacting the Cemetery Office and speaking to a Family Service Counselor. Shelving inside the storage building will be marked with the name of each garden in the Park. Seasonal items removed from the grounds will be stored accordingly and available for you to pick up. After 30 days, they will be discarded. Holiday items will be stored through the end of January. 
• One American Flag or Armed Forces Flag on a maximum 24” wooden stick may be placed near headstones. 
• Rest Haven Memorial Park is not responsible for maintaining, replacing, or safeguarding items placed on gravesites. 
• Decorations other than flowers and appropriate holiday greenery are not allowed. This includes but is not limited to shepherd crooks, lamps, solar lights, pinwheels, wind chimes, fencing, plantings, landscape rock, any ceramic or glass items, anything stuck into the ground (rods, brackets, posts, poles, etc.), or anything else placed on or around the grave other than approved flowers in an approved flower vase. These items are subject to removal by our staff at any time without notice. 

### Guidelines for Landscaping

In all sections of the Cemetery, landscaping and planting privileges are strictly limited to cemetery personnel. However, designated property is available and may be purchased to plant trees for use in family memorials. Such planting must be approved and strictly supervised by the Cemetery Management. Rest Haven Memorial Park reserves the right to name, design, develop, and place all free-standing memorials, statues, foundations, signage, and embellishments at its discretion in the Cemetery. No individuals or organizations will be permitted to do so independently. Special Rules for Custom Estates and Built-to-Suit Estates: These areas may include designated areas for family-maintained flower beds. Families may plant flowers and plants within designated estate areas as long as the plantings grow no higher than the surrounding hedge or border. The Cemetery is not responsible for the

Page 2 of 2 April 17, 2024 maintenance of custom flower beds and may, at its discretion, remove any plantings deemed to be unsightly or inappropriate. Custom estates may also contain decorative items that are not allowed in community gardens. Any decorative items may not extend higher than the estate border and must be contained within designated beds. Windchimes or other noise-producing decorations are not allowed. Trees planted in estate areas must be planted by the Cemetery with prior approval.

### Temporary Memorials

Flat stone temporary grave markers are available from the Cemetery. Only cemetery-approved temporary markers may be placed in the Cemetery. Temporary markers will be removed after six months unless a permanent memorial has been ordered. Metal temporary markers are not allowed. No homemade markers or monuments are allowed. All memorials must be cemetery-approved.

### Guidelines for Visitors

Rest Haven Memorial Park's visiting hours are daily, from sunrise to sunset. An adult should accompany children under sixteen and always supervise young children. The speed limit in the Cemetery is 10 mph. Firearms and other weapons are prohibited on cemetery grounds. Disorderly conduct, use of illegal or illicit substances, or behavior that is disrespectful to staff or other visitors may result in removal from the premises, being banned from the property, or trespass charges. Pets must be leashed at all times. Please clean up after your pet when you visit the Cemetery. Recreational vehicles, buses, or trailers are allowed by special permission and must check in at the business office before entering the Cemetery.

### Bronze Marker and Granite Monument Disclosure Regarding the Order & Installation of Your Personalized Memorial

Rest Haven Memorial Park must order your burial marker or monument not later than 21 days after you have 
paid 100% of the cost of the marker or monument; you have paid in full all charges for the interment spaces and 
corresponding required perpetual care, you have paid in full any marker or monument setting fees; you have 
approved the lettering and design for the marker or monument; and you have signed the necessary 
documentation directing or authorizing Rest Haven Memorial Park to order the marker or monument. 
Rest Haven Memorial Park must set your marker no later than 15 days after inspection and acceptance by our 
Family Service Counselor, and you have paid in full all charges for the marker and interment spaces, including 
required perpetual care and any setting fees. 
Rest Haven Memorial Park must set your monument no later than 25 days after inspection and acceptance by 
our Family Service Counselor, and you have paid in full all charges for the monument and interment spaces, 
including required perpetual care and any setting fees. 
If Rest Haven Memorial Park is unable to set your burial marker or monument by the deadlines as mentioned 
above, Rest Haven Memorial Park will notify you in writing no later than the 5th day after the date by which 
your marker or monument is required to be set and inform you of the reason for the delay, and the date by 
which Rest Haven Memorial Park expects to be able to set your marker or monument. 
All markers and monuments must be set within the statutory time parameters unless the purchaser has stipulated 
in writing their wish that the marker or monument be set later than required under these prerequisites.
